best_idea: A hit kicks the view with a short triangle envelope (up in 100 ms, back down in 400 ms) whose strength is damage scaled up as health falls, and paints a red blob on the side the hit came from, so the player can read direction and severity without a HUD.
decision_why: Keep the 100/400 ms envelope and the health-scaled, clamped kick for world-camera hits (row 10); the donor applies both effects to first person only, so the world camera adds them explicitly and uses a screen-edge marker. The donor's byte-direction decode (256 vs 255 scale) is fixed by sending vectors; the Pit camera is frozen, so the kick is off there.
acceptance: In the world, a 20-damage hit at 100 hp gives a kick of 8 degrees at full strength reached at 100 ms and back to 0 by 500 ms; a red edge marker on the hit side fades from alpha 200 to 0 over 500 ms; a server test asserts the hit event carries damage, health after the hit, and a direction vector or a centred flag for falls.
